notes: Verified against score-treatment.md, score-peer-notes.jsonl, score-reconciliation.jsonl and the compiled director-notes.jsonl (note-sc-01, note-sc-02, note-ch-01, note-ci-02 reproduced verbatim). No cue by contract: score.cues holds the single cue-station-silence entry bound through every anchor, mixIntent and performancePlan create no bus, and silenceIntent records the station's silence as unspent inventory whose only route is the deferred station-audio packet.

concourse-open is one runtime instant: t=0 at the first occupiedCellId change into the concourse cell, identical in story mode (story:ch11-concourse-entered commits in the same effect) and the standalone sandbox; the 1.4 s ramp and the low line are consequences, never second triggers. concourse-leave is present as the first cell change out through either portal in both modes, with THRESHOLD_FADE_SECONDS for the destination (hall 1.0, counter 0.8) from a live-fill snapshot, monotone, no overshoot, no low-line re-run.

The concourse ramp is finite and monotone by assertion: progress 0 at t=0, at least 0.95 by +1.2 s, exactly 1.0 at +1.4 s, no overshoot at any of seven samples, retained under reduced motion as a monotone, finite, non-periodic scene event. Those numbers are consistent with the accepted smoothstep form (95% at 0.81 D = +1.13 s).

No periodic luminance: strips are static radius-0 emissives outside the pool, no fitting tracks, breathes or brightens toward the player, the entry acknowledgement is one-shot per objective id, the ramp is one-shot per threshold. No tempo is installed for a future cue grid.

Silence evidence is contracted as required: zero AudioContext, webkitAudioContext and OfflineAudioContext constructions and zero HTMLMediaElement play calls, window.__voxSfxDiag undefined at every sample, across district teleports, pointer lock, a vendor panel cycle and all three story objective id changes, desktop and mobile, before and after implementation; a console error naming AudioContext is a hard failure; reset-score repeats the same criterion across every reset trigger.

Gap 1 (non-blocking, carried to implementation evidence): the contract does not itself print the full per-district THRESHOLD_FADE_SECONDS column (concourse 1.4 / floor 1.0 / apron, counter, shelves 0.8), the THRESHOLD_FADE_EASE = smoothstep name, the 95%-at-0.81 D relation, or the phrase that these constants are exported by name. The direction rule survives only as prose (ev-leave-concourse: the warmth withdraws faster than it arrived). The accepted wording lives in director-notes.jsonl note-sc-02 (cinematography response) and note-ci-02 (score response). Integration must implement those exports as named constants in SpaceStationLighting and the verifier must cite them by name in the implementation evidence; a future station-audio packet contract must reference the exports, never a transcribed number.

Gap 2 (non-blocking): the low-line presentation delay is asserted numerically (caption opacity 0 through +0.8 s and while progress under 0.6; 1 at +1.2 s with progress at least 0.9) and called a named delay, but no constant name (CONCOURSE_LOW_LINE_OFFSET_SECONDS-style) appears in the contract. Acceptable for a no-cue revision because the anchor, not the offset, is what a cue binds to; the constant must exist by name in code and be reported in evidence.

Gap 3 (evidence routing): capture-audio-silence should run its story-mode objective-id steps on the same seeded story save Integration supplies for capture-hud-stills; the contract states that dependency only on the HUD capture. No second route is needed; the verifier should say so in the result.

contractChangeRequired: false for this revision. None of the three gaps changes motif meaning, arrangement, silence, objective-feedback meaning, cue relationships, or a shared anchor; they are naming and evidence-routing obligations at the implementation gate. If any implemented fade is not a finite monotone ramp from the cell-change timestamp, or any fitting acquires a period, that is a contract change and reopens the cycle.
